## Developer Guide

If you are new to using `nbdev` here are some useful pointers to get you started.

### Install demo_seib in Development mode

``` sh
# make sure demo_seib package is installed in development mode
$ pip install -e .

# make changes under nbs/ directory
# ...

# compile to have changes apply to demo_seib
$ nbdev_prepare
```

## Usage

### Installation

Install latest from the GitHub [repository](https://github.com/franckalbinet/demo-seib):

``` sh
$ pip install git+https://github.com/franckalbinet/demo-seib.git
```

or from [conda](https://anaconda.org/franckalbinet/demo-seib)

``` sh
$ conda install -c franckalbinet demo_seib
```

or from [pypi](https://pypi.org/project/demo-seib/)

``` sh
$ pip install demo_seib
```

### Documentation

Documentation can be found hosted on this GitHub [repository](https://github.com/franckalbinet/demo-seib)’s [pages](https://franckalbinet.github.io/demo-seib/). Additionally you can find package manager specific guidelines on [conda](https://anaconda.org/franckalbinet/demo-seib) and [pypi](https://pypi.org/project/demo-seib/) respectively.
